title: Canon EOS 850D / Rebel T8i 24.1MP Travel DSLR (Best DSLR for Travel)
purpose: The premier travel and walkaround APS-C DSLR ('Best DSLR for Travel'): 24.1MP APS-C CMOS sensor, DIGIC 8 processor, 45-point all cross-type optical AF + Dual Pixel CMOS AF with Eye Detection, 220k-pixel RGB+IR metering, 7 fps burst, and versatile Nano USM travel optics.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 22.3 x 14.9mm APS-C CMOS sensor with Dual Pixel CMOS AF (24.1MP, 6000 x 4000)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Canon EF-S 18-135mm f/3.5-5.6 IS USM (29-216mm equivalent Nano USM Travel Zoom)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 100 base sensitivity (ISO 100–25,600, expandable to ISO 51,200)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 13.3 EV dynamic range with DIGIC 8 highlight tone priority and balanced travel daylight latitude
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 1/4000s to 30s mechanical shutter, 7 fps continuous shooting, 1/200s flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Sun-drenched travel daylight, golden-hour piazza light, or vibrant street market illumination at ISO 100
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Natural outdoor light transport with warm Canon color rendering, balanced sky-to-shadow exposure via 220k-pixel RGB+IR metering, and crisp architectural micro-contrast

surface_rendering: 24.1MP APS-C CMOS sensor resolving weathered stone facades, market textiles, natural skin pores, and coastal water ripples with clean tonal gradation
DIGIC 8 color science delivering pleasing skin tones, rich azure skies, and authentic environmental textures
Optical image stabilization (4-stop IS) ensuring tack-sharp handheld travel documentary frames
depth_and_optics: 45-point all cross-type optical viewfinder AF and Dual Pixel CMOS AF with Eye Detection locked on travel subjects
Versatile 29-216mm equivalent focal range framing both wide architectural plazas and compressed candid street portraits
Natural optical depth of field without synthetic smartphone background cutout artifacts

execution_directive: Enforce Canon EOS 850D (Rebel T8i) 24.1MP APS-C travel DSLR optical versatility with 45-point all cross-type AF, DIGIC 8 color science, and sharp handheld travel documentary realism.
